lines.en: label wakanasummer2nightgen:
scene wakanasummer2nightgen
I somehow find myself going over to Wakana’s apartment after calling her and finding out that Osako is going to be working late tonight.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我打给 Wakana、发现 Osako 今晚要加班之后，就到了她的公寓。

lines.en: And while that may potentially make it sound as if the two of us are doing something inappropriate behind her back, I can assure you that it is anything but.
lines.zh: 虽然这听起来可能像是我俩背着她干了什么不合适的事，但我可以保证完全不是。

lines.en: Instead, the two of us sit on separate couches in her incense-filled living room slash bedroom and watch some televised documentary about the occult in Japan.
lines.zh: 相反，我俩坐在她那间既是客厅又是卧室、满是熏香味的屋子里的两张不同沙发上，看一部讲日本神秘学的电视纪录片。

lines.en: And while that’s not something I’d typically find myself getting interested in, the fact that I am very much currently living in a scenario that many would describe as “occult” makes me reevaluate that.
lines.zh: 虽然这通常不是我会感兴趣的东西，但我现在正活在一个很多人会形容为「神秘学」的场景里，这让我重新掂量了一下。

lines.en: Unfortunately, the series on the television is primarily focused on aliens and I have a hard time believing they have any part in the manipulation of time and our world as a whole.
lines.zh: 可惜，电视上那系列主要讲外星人，而我很难相信它们跟时间以及我们整个世界的操纵有什么关系。

lines.en: But, then again, we’re also apparently in the middle of a space war- so I guess anything is possible.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我们显然也正处在一场太空战争里——所以我想什么都有可能。

lines.en: scene black
Osako comes home to find the two of us watching television and quickly needs to force herself into pretending that she’s not jealous that I’m spending time with her girlfriend.
lines.zh: Osako 回家时发现我俩在看电视，不得不强迫自己装出不嫉妒我跟她女朋友待在一起的样子。

lines.en: Wakana takes notice of this and teases her about it. But, in doing so, makes it sound like she would never be interested in me that way, which I take great offense to.
lines.zh: Wakana 注意到了，还拿这事逗她。可这么一来，听起来就像她永远不会对我有那种兴趣，这让我大为恼火。

lines.en: I guess just being friends is fine for now, though. It’s not like I want to fuck {i}every{/i} girl in Kumon-mi. Just-
lines.zh: 不过我想现在光是做朋友也挺好。我又不是想睡 Kumon-mi 的{i}每一个{/i}女孩。只是——

lines.en: Actually...no. I’d definitely still have sex with her if given the opportunity.
lines.zh: 其实……不。要是有机会，我肯定还是会跟她上床的。

lines.en: But I don’t {i}have{/i} to do that and can probably live with the idea of it just...not happening.
lines.zh: 但我不是{i}非得{/i}那样，大概也能接受这件事就……不发生。

lines.en: I just hope that it does.
I really hope that it does.
Anyway, it quickly becomes apparent that the reason for me being here has vanished, and so I bid the two of them goodbye and make my way out of the apartment.
lines.zh: 总之，很快就清楚我来这儿的理由已经没了，于是我跟她俩道别，走出了公寓。

lines.en: As I do, I notice John outside of Kaori’s apartment- staring off into space, entirely unaware of my presence.
lines.zh: 走出去时，我注意到 John 在 Kaori 公寓外面——盯着虚空发呆，完全没察觉我在。

lines.en: I leave before he notices me and manage to make it home without interacting with any animals.
lines.zh: 我趁他没发现就走了，一路上没跟任何动物打交道，顺利到家。
